items.headline: Junior Sherrill details how Vandy turns the page from NC State win
items.description: With the Commodores' SEC opener ahead, Sherrill joins The Paul Finebaum Show and describes how they're moving on from the Wolfpack win and preparing to face the Tigers.

items.headline: Week 4 Game Day Kickoff: Can Oregon turn a corner? Is USC for real?
items.description: Week 4 will tell us if our knee-jerk reactions to the first few weeks of the season actually mean anything.

items.headline: Analyzing where Auburn needs to improve ahead of must-win game vs. Vandy
items.description: SEC Network's Gene Chizik breaks down the improvements that the Tigers must make defensively as he discusses why the pressure is high for them to secure a win over the Commodores.

items.headline: Clark Lea outlines Vandy's next step after win vs. NC State
items.description: Lea joins SEC Now and explains the Commodores' trajectory after beating the Wolfpack and how he wants them to continue improving and imposing their will on opponents.

items.headline: NC State QB CJ Bailey addresses costly fumble vs. Vanderbilt
items.description: In his first comments since he fumbled in the end zone with one second left against Vanderbilt, leading to a shocking loss for the Wolfpack, NC State QB CJ Bailey said he "was trying to get all the clock out. That was my thought. ... I fumbled the ball."

items.headline: Fozzy's SEC Tiers: Which middle-tier teams are ready to break through?
items.description: After dividing the 16 SEC teams into four tiers, Fozzy Whitaker explains his rationale while fellow SEC Now analyst Gene Chizik weighs in.
